selection.include_rule: select every candidate with complete mandatory PRE inputs; no stopping, replacement, deletion, or post-outcome filtering

primary_criteria.C1: NL2 mean multiclass logloss must be at least 0.02 lower than B1a on identical scored races
primary_criteria.C2: NL2 mean logloss lower than B1a in at least 3 of 5 meetings
primary_criteria.C3: NL2 Top3 accuracy no more than 0.02 below B1a
primary_criteria.C4: NL2 Top1 accuracy no more than 0.02 below B1a

decision: PASS iff coverage gate and all C1-C4 pass; FAIL iff coverage gate passes and any C1-C4 fails; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
notes: The fixed meetings were chosen before dedicated target scoring for this NL2 validation. This rule must not be edited after result access; any pre-result acquisition failure requires a newly versioned rule.
